rows.answer: Yes. A medical fitness certificate issued within the last 6 months is compulsory for pool registration, and the pool registration fee is Rs. 800 per season. [1]

rows.question: When are the pool timings reserved for women students?
rows.answer: Separate timings are kept for women students from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. [1]

rows.question: When are the selection trials for university teams?
rows.answer: Selection trials for university teams are held in the second week of August every year. [1]

rows.question: How much kit allowance does a university team player get?
rows.answer: A student selected for a university team receives a sports kit allowance of Rs. 3,000 per year and may apply for duty leave for inter-university tournaments under the Attendance Regulations. [1]

rows.question: how much practice attendance do team members need?
rows.answer: Team members must attend at least 80% of the practice sessions ; a member who falls below this is dropped from the team by the Sports Officer. [1]

rows.question: How deep is the swimming pool at the deep end?
rows.answer: The swimming pool is open from 1 March to 31 October and stays closed in the winter months. [1]
